prompt:
You are a senior information designer and editorial typographer who sets data tables for high-quality publications (statistical yearbooks, reference works, financial reports, technical documentation) in many writing systems, including Chinese. You judge by looking at the real rendered result.

Judge a table layout on all of these levels, in this order of necessity but as one whole:
1. correctness — every character visible, structure intact, nothing clipped or overlapping;
2. readability — natural line breaks, words/numbers/identifiers/semantic units kept whole, continuous reading;
3. function — easy to look up, compare, locate and understand the information for this table's real reading tasks;
4. visual order — alignment, grouping, hierarchy, consistent scale for elements with the same role;
5. visual rhythm — proportion, density changes, distribution of white space, spatial relationships;
6. overall aesthetics — balance, restraint, naturalness, harmony.
Do not assume that equal widths, symmetry, minimum height, the fewest lines, the golden ratio or any fixed proportion is good in itself; decide from this table's function, content and reading task, and look for counter-examples to your own rules.

Table: 个人所得税专项附加扣除标准简表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: yes.
Merged cells: "扣除项目" spans 1 col × 2 row; "每月标准（元）" spans 2 col × 1 row; "适用条件" spans 1 col × 2 row.
Measured content facts (text px at 15px font, padding excluded):
  col 1: header "扣除项目" · longest unbreakable unit 16px · widest one-line content 133px
  col 2: header "每月标准（元） › 一般地区" · longest unbreakable unit 37px · widest one-line content 203px
  col 3: header "每月标准（元） › 特殊情形" · longest unbreakable unit 48px · widest one-line content 435px
  col 4: header "适用条件" · longest unbreakable unit 39px · widest one-line content 1038px
Each column adds 21px of padding+border to its text width.
Viewport: 360px wide (dashed pink box in the renders). The table, including its 1px outer border, must be at most 360px wide (column widths sum to at most 359px); no horizontal scrolling. A table exactly 360px wide fits.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. Only the column widths are designed; row heights follow from them.

Your understanding: {"purpose":"帮助个人按扣除项目查找每月扣除标准及其适用条件。","tasks":["按项目名称定位所需扣除","横向比较同一项目的一般地区与特殊情形标准","阅读适用条件，判断标准是否适合自己的情况","在多个项目之间比较可扣除金额"],"relations":["每行的项目、两类标准和适用条件共同构成一项扣除信息","一般地区和特殊情形同属于每月标准，比较时应保持相邻","括号中的限定语与其所修饰的金额或情形一起决定标准的含义"],"roles":["第一列是行标题，也是查找入口","第二、三列是并列的标准列，表头由共同的每月标准标题统领","第四列解释适用条件，文字最长","两行表头体现标准列的分组，其余表头跨两行"],"keep_whole":["金额和数字","项目名称中的词语及年龄表达","括号内的限定语尽量与相关金额保持邻近","表头中的词语和单位"],"may_wrap":["较长的项目名称可在自然词语边界换行","标准中的金额与较长限定语可分行","适用条件可按语义分句换行"],"same_scale":["一般地区和特殊情形是并列标准列，应有可比较的视觉分量，但特殊情形文字更长时可更宽","各行项目名称承担相同的导航角色","各行适用条件承担相同的解释角色"],"h_vs_v":"360px内无法让长条件和标准都保持单行；增加条件列宽度可减少正文换行和表格高度，但会挤压项目与标准列，使查找和横向比较更费力。增加标准列宽度则有利于比较，却会让条件向下延伸。"}

Image 1 is the one-line content overview. Then real browser renders of: d1r4A, d1r4B, d1r4C, d1r3A.
Measured facts:
d1r4A: column widths [66, 81, 78, 134] px · table 360×1523 px · row heights [36, 60, 246, 222, 246, 246, 222, 246] · column headers on >1 line: 3/5 · tallest cell 10 lines · measured breaks inside a word: 34 · fits the 360 px viewport (no scrolling)
d1r4B: column widths [81, 60, 78, 140] px · table 360×1500 px · row heights [36, 60, 246, 199, 246, 246, 222, 246] · column headers on >1 line: 3/5 · tallest cell 10 lines · measured breaks inside a word: 41 · fits the 360 px viewport (no scrolling)
d1r4C: column widths [65, 60, 78, 156] px · table 360×1384 px · row heights [36, 60, 246, 176, 222, 222, 199, 222] · column headers on >1 line: 3/5 · tallest cell 10 lines · measured breaks inside a word: 27 · fits the 360 px viewport (no scrolling)
d1r3A: column widths [65, 60, 87, 147] px · table 360×1361 px · row heights [36, 60, 199, 199, 222, 222, 199, 222] · column headers on >1 line: 2/5 · tallest cell 9 lines · measured breaks inside a word: 31 · fits the 360 px viewport (no scrolling)

Look at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design: what works, what is visually wrong, and the cause (which width). Then either propose up to 3 improved designs (refine the most promising, fix what you saw, or try an important unexplored idea) or, if further changes would not bring a meaningful improvement, set "done": true. Do not resubmit near-identical widths.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"best":["your best design name(s) so far"],"done":false,"designs":[{"widths":[int px],"change":"what and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"d1r4A","good":"一般地区列较宽，金额及其限定语比其他几个方案更容易阅读；两类标准相邻，表格完整适配视口。","problems":"特殊情形和适用条件都被挤成很窄的文字带，首行特殊情形长达十行；项目名称如“3岁以下婴幼儿照护”也被割得零碎。大量高行使查找和横向对照费力。","cause":"第一列66px、特殊情形列78px和条件列134px均偏紧；一般地区列81px占用了条件列和特殊情形列可用的空间。"},{"design":"d1r4B","good":"项目列更宽，“3岁以下”等片段更容易辨认；条件列比A略宽，部分行有所缩短。","problems":"“子女教育”“住房租金”等项目名称仍在词语中间断开；一般地区的“直辖市、省会城市等”被拆得尤其零碎，两个标准表头也都换行。条件和特殊情形仍很拥挤。","cause":"项目列81px不足以稳定容纳更多完整名称，却压缩一般地区列至60px；特殊情形78px和条件140px仍限制长文本。"},{"design":"d1r4C","good":"条件列最宽，正文比A、B舒展，整体更短；四列关系清楚，金额基本容易定位。","problems":"首行仍被特殊情形拖至十行，“特殊情形”表头断开；一般地区的租金限定语以及多个项目名称断得零碎。","cause":"条件列156px改善了长正文，但特殊情形列仅78px，一般地区列60px、项目列65px也都很紧。"},{"design":"d1r3A","good":"特殊情形表头保持一行，首行特殊情形比C少一行；整体是四个方案中最短的，标准与条件之间的空间分配较均衡。","problems":"一般地区列中的租金限定语仍被拆碎，项目名称尤其是“3岁以下婴幼儿照护”不易连续阅读；条件列中仍有一些词语和金额单位跨行。","cause":"特殊情形列87px达到表头单行所需宽度，但项目列65px和一般地区列60px仍过窄；条件列147px也不足以避免所有不自然换行。"}],"best":["d1r3A"],"done":false,"designs":[{"widths":[81,66,87,125],"change":"保留特殊情形表头单行，将空间转向项目名称和一般地区，检验改善查找及标准阅读是否值得条件列增高。"},{"widths":[72,60,87,140],"change":"在d1r3A基础上适度加宽项目列，保留特殊情形表头单行，并观察条件列略缩后对正文和行高的影响。"},{"widths":[65,75,87,132],"change":"保留d1r3A的项目列和特殊情形列，把15px从条件列转给一般地区，检验租金等限定语的改善与条件正文变窄之间的取舍。"}]}
